spring1901_aus_press.txt is the exact SYSTEM + blank line + USER text that the
unchanged oorexx_diplomacy v0.1-dev7r1 DiplomacyPlayer rendered for Austria's
first 1901 Spring press call (designer prompt "Play well.", rules text "RULES
TEXT"). Captured with a recording engine; the tests splice prompts, mail,
results and memory into it so every case starts from the framework's own text.

constructs.txt was written by Claude (Opus 5.5). Each line exercises one sentence
construction that designers' drafts showed the v0.1 reader got wrong or did not
read (a before-clause, a relative clause, a negative quantity on the object, a
kept condition, a negating verb before an -ing form, a bare build). It holds no
designer's prompt: designer prompts are sealed until the competition unseals them.
